name: Ointment
overview: Scripture presents ointment both as a sacred substance and a practical element in daily life. The anointing oil, compounded by Bezaleel according to a divine formula involving spices like myrrh and cinnamon (Exodus 30:23, 37:29), was used to consecrate the tabernacle and its furnishings (Exodus 30:26), highlighting its sacred role. Conversely, ointment also had non-sacred uses, such as in the personal purification rituals described in Esther 2:12. Ecclesiastes 7:1 contrasts the value of a good name with precious ointment, underscoring that while ointment has worth, spiritual integrity surpasses it.
